mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_NOTIFICATION ( USERNAME, NOTIFICATION_TYPE, TITLE, MESSAGE, RELATED_TYPE, RELATED_ID, RELATED_URL, IS_READ, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{notificationType}, #{title}, #{message}, #{relatedType}, #{relatedId}, #{relatedUrl}, 0, NOW(), #{createdBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT n.NOTIFICATION_ID, n.USERNAME, n.NOTIFICATION_TYPE, n.TITLE, n.MESSAGE, n.RELATED_TYPE, n.RELATED_ID, n.RELATED_URL, n.IS_READ, n.READ_AT, n.CREATED_AT, n.CREATED_BY, u.NAME AS CREATED_BY_NAME FROM TB_NOTIFICATION n LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON n.CREATED_BY = u.USERNAME WHERE n.NOTIFICATION_ID = #{notificationId}

mapper.update: UPDATE TB_NOTIFICATION SET IS_READ = 1, READ_AT = NOW() WHERE NOTIFICATION_ID = #{notificationId} AND IS_READ = 0

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_NOTIFICATION WHERE CREATED_AT < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{daysOld} DAY)
